en-US.description: Full-featured out-of-box, all-round protection, stronger with use
en-US.longDescription:
- Built-in access to 16 leading large-model providers, offering dozens of top-tier models in one place
  One-time activation · Zero-configuration integration · Intelligent scheduling · Best-in-class model experience
- OpenClaw is more than just chat; with its skill capabilities, it gets things done for you
  13,000+ built-in skills · 4 million open-source software tools · Automatic completion of complex tasks
- Comes with 13,000+ skills covering office work, marketing, writing, and more—common tasks completed directly
  Ready out of the box · Continuously expanding 13,000+ capabilities · No API key configuration needed for paid tools
- Use NamiClaw right within your chat applications
  Connect to various IM platforms with one click; let OpenClaw handle your tasks directly from the chat window
- Use with confidence: NamiClaw won't cause trouble
  A comprehensive AI security framework spanning the entire pipeline, powered by prompt protection, tool permission isolation, skill auditing, and multiple other mechanisms
- NamiClaw is free to install
  Usage requires purchasing Compute Beans, which are consumed for AI computation
  Compute Beans are used to invoke large-model capabilities and are consumed during requirement communication, data processing, task execution, and related operations

zh-CN.description: 出厂满血 全能守护 越用越强
zh-CN.longDescription:
- 内置 16 家主流大模型厂商，数十个顶级模型一站式使用
  一次开通 · 零配置接入 · 智能调度 · 最强模型体验
- 龙虾不止是聊天，会使用技能的它能帮你把事情做完
  13000+ 内置技能 ·400 万开源软件 · 自动完成复杂任务
- 内置 13000+ 技能，覆盖办公、营销、写作等，常见工作直接完成
  开箱即用 ·13000+ 能力持续扩展 · 付费工具无需配置 Key
- 在聊天工具里就能用 360 安全龙虾
  一键连接各种 IM 软件，在聊天窗口就能让龙虾帮你完成工作
- 放心用，360 安全龙虾不会惹麻烦
  通过提示词防护、工具权限隔离、技能审核等多重机制，打造贯穿 AI 全链路的安全体系
- 360 安全龙虾客户端免费安装
  使用时需购买算力豆，用于消耗 AI 算力
  算力豆用于调用大模型能力，在沟通需求、处理数据、执行任务等过程中都会消耗算力豆
